mapper.select:
SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, ENTRUST_ID id FROM ETR_ENTRUST
AND ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_STATUS IN(#{entrustAwait},#{entrustDistribute},#{entrustReceive},#{entrustUntread},#{entrustClose},#{entrustReturn},#{entrustRecall})
AND ENTRUST_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')

SELECT T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, T1.FINPROD_ABBR text, T1.FINPROD_NAME, T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.CALENDAR_ID, T1.TRADE_MARKET, T1.IS_RIGHT, T2.TYPE_9, T2.TYPE_10, T2.TYPE_11, to_char(T1.VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') VDATE, to_char(T1.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') MDATE, T1.CCY, null as PRICE FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN MST_BOND_MARKET_INFO mbmi ON T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = mbmi.SEC_ID AND mbmi.VALUE_DATE = #{platDate,jdbcType=DATE}

SELECT distinct SYS_USER.USER_NAME id, SYS_USER.REAL_NAME text ,SYS_USER.DEPT_CODE deptCode FROM SYS_USER INNER JOIN SYS_USER_ROLE ON SYS_USER.USER_NAME = SYS_USER_ROLE.USER_ID INNER JOIN SYS_ROLE ON SYS_USER_ROLE.ROLE_ID = SYS_ROLE.ROLE_ID
AND SYS_ROLE.ROLE_POS IN( #{roleOne}, #{roleTwo} )
AND (SYS_USER.USER_NAME like concat(concat('%', #{manager,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR SYS_USER.REAL_NAME like concat(concat('%', #{manager,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%'))
mapper.insert: insert into ETR_ENTRUST_OPER_HIS (SEQ_NO, ENTRUST_ID, OPER_TYPE, OPER_DATE, OPER_TIME, BUSI_DES, USER_ID, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME ) values (#{seqNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{operType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{operDate,jdbcType=DATE}, sysdate, #{busiDes,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sysdate, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR},sysdate )
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO.PARTY_ID id, MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO.PARTY_ABBR text, MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO.PARTY_ID as object FROM MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO
AND (MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO.PARTY_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) or MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO.PARTY_ABBR like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')))

SELECT distinct t1.user_name id, t1.real_name text FROM sys_user t1 WHERE 1 = 1
AND (t1.user_name like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) or t1.real_name like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')))
mapper.insert:
MERGE INTO ETR_ENTRUST_OPER_HIS EEOP USING (
SELECT '${item.seqNo}' SEQ_NO, '${item.entrustId}' ENTRUST_ID, '${item.operType}' OPER_TYPE, #{item.operDate,jdbcType=DATE} OPER_DATE, #{item.operTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} OPER_TIME, '${item.busiDes}' BUSI_DES, '${item.userId}' USER_ID, '${item.createUser}' CREATE_USER, '${item.createDept}' CREATE_DEPT, sysdate CREATE_TIME, '${item.updateUser}' UPDATE_USER, sysdate UPDATE_TIME FROM dual
) TEMP
ON(EEOP.ENTRUST_ID = TEMP.ENTRUST_ID and EEOP.OPER_TYPE = TEMP.OPER_TYPE )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET STATISTICAL_TIMES = NVL(STATISTICAL_TIMES,0)+1, CREATE_USER = TEMP.CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME = TEMP.CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (SEQ_NO, ENTRUST_ID, OPER_TYPE, OPER_DATE, OPER_TIME, BUSI_DES, USER_ID, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME,STATISTICAL_TIMES) values (TEMP.SEQ_NO, TEMP.ENTRUST_ID, TEMP.OPER_TYPE, TEMP.OPER_DATE, TEMP.OPER_TIME, TEMP.BUSI_DES, TEMP.USER_ID, TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, TEMP.CREATE_TIME, TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME,1)
mapper.select: SELECT decode(sp.is_need_workflow,#{yesOrNo02},#{yesOrNoN}, #{yesOrNo01},decode(swbm.module_id, #{noneApproval}, #{yesOrNoN}, #{yesOrNoY})) from sys_wfl_business_module swbm left join sys_page sp on sp.page_id = swbm.page_id where swbm.page_id = #{pageId} and swbm.element_id = #{element_id}
SELECT TOTLE_TRADE_ID id FROM WFL_REG_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL UNION SELECT TOTLE_TRADE_ID id FROM REG_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL rfpdt

SELECT A.VDATE startDate, A.MDATE endDate, ( SELECT MIN(C.VDATE) FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN C WHERE C.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID ) firstPayDate, A.ISSUE_PRICE issuePrice, A.COUPON_SPECIES bondsType, E.BASIS basis,
F.INT_TYPE intRateType, G.PAY_CYCLE yearIntRate, G.CALC_RULE calMethod, H.EXERCISE_DATE nextExeDate, H.EXERCISE_PRICE nextExercisePrice, A.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, A.IS_RIGHT isRight FROM FIN_PRODUCT A LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID AND B.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType} AND B.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE D ON D.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID
left join (select FINPROD_ID, max(eff_date) as EFF_DATE from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE where FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} and IS_INITIAL = #{YES_NO_Y} group by FINPROD_ID) T1 on T1.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE E ON E.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID AND E.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} and E.IS_INITIAL = #{YES_NO_Y} and E.EFF_DATE = T1.EFF_DATE LEFT JOIN FIN_RATE_INFO F ON F.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID AND F.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE G ON G.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID AND G.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN WHERE EXERCISE_DATE IN ( SELECT MIN(EXERCISE_DATE) FROM FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} AND EXERCISE_DATE >= #{sysDate} ) AND FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} AND EXERCISE_TYPE = #{EXEC_MODE02} AND EXERCISE_TYPE = #{EXEC_MODE01} and rownum = 1 ) H ON 1=1 WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
